[ASSISTANT_SAID] In "How to Fail at Almost Everything and Still Win Big," Adams talks about the concept of "skill stacking," which involves building a diverse set of skills that can be combined in unique and valuable ways.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Having a diverse set of skills can increase value and competitiveness in the job market.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For artists, building a strong skill stack could involve developing skills in technical art, business and marketing, and communication and collaboration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Identifying areas where their skill stack is strong and where it may need improvement could help artists identify opportunities for growth and development.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Artists could start by making a list of their existing skills and considering which additional skills they would like to develop.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Artists should think about which skills are most in demand in their field and how they might acquire or enhance those skills.
